about: T-7788: the pre-production assistant gate's ten questions, asked in one conversation of the public AssistantDeployment helsinki/gate (deployment.yaml) on jc-dev. Schema of the answer evals (assistant tests/fixtures/answer_evals/questions.json: id, lang, ask, facts, evidence, refuse) plus `lane` and, for a data question, `read`: the anonymous MCP query_entities the runner makes on the Endpoint right before it asks, from which it writes the expected `facts` and the `evidence` (every value of the rows read). `hosts` lists where a cited page may live (`{domain}` is the run's --domain). `knownBad` holds answers a fit model judge must fail, asked in the same judge call; `prices` turns uncosted tokens into USD (an estimate: it reproduces 0.0248 USD for 13,665 in and 1,191 out on jc-prod turn 34).
